name: compliance-gdpr-consent-strip
title: Compliance GDPR Consent Strip
description: A regulatory privacy consent banner supporting essential, analytical, and marketing preference toggles.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Compliance Gdpr Consent Strip Interaction: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
